"Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jesse breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Erin breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
